description: Object Organization V1 — cross-client contract for reclassify, bulk_mutate, move, organize, relate, merge, reference_rewrite, fix_identification, rule_change, and rule_migration operations.

operationModel.description: Every structural or bulk operation must carry a stable operationId, scope, preconditions, plannedActions, warnings, blockers, and recoverySemantics. Rerunning the same operation after UI rerender, retry, restart, or partial I/O failure must not duplicate effects.

fields.operationId: Stable deterministic ID for idempotency. NOT a timestamp.
fields.kind: One of the operation kinds listed in this contract.
fields.createdAt: ISO-8601 timestamp — informational only, not used as idempotency key.
fields.baseSettingsRevision: The object_identification.revision value at plan time. Precondition: must still match at Apply time.
fields.scope: ResolvedOrganizationScope describing files, folders, eligibleMarkdownPaths, indexedObjectIds, unidentifiedMarkdownPaths, ignoredAttachments, ignoredBases, duplicatesRemoved.
fields.affectedObjectIds: Object IDs that will be mutated.
fields.affectedPaths: Vault-relative paths that will be read or written.
fields.preconditions: Conditions that must hold at Apply time: settings revision valid, object ID still matches, source path valid, hash/markdown matches preview, destination absent, reference graph valid, survivor/losers exist, no new incompatibilities.
fields.plannedActions: Ordered list of actions; each action is individually idempotent.
fields.warnings: Non-blocking issues visible to user before Apply.
fields.blockers: Blocking issues that prevent Apply. Must be shown before Apply is offered.
fields.recoverySemantics: How to resume or roll back after partial I/O failure. Must distinguish: not-yet-applied, already-applied-exactly, state-changed-abort.

reclassify.description: Change identified objects to satisfy an existing TypeSignature. Does NOT change the TypeSignature itself.

bulk_mutate.description: Apply explicit property operations (Set, Add, Remove, Clear, Leave unchanged) to a scope of objects. Empty input never means delete.
invariants: capability intersection applied for mixed types

move.description: Move objects to a destination folder. Does NOT automatically change type unless reclassify is composed.
invariants: manual Explorer move is observed, not auto-reversed
mismatch after manual move becomes an Issue, not automatic correction

organize.description: Composite operation: reclassify + move + property mutations + relationship mutations. Planned as a single operation, not improvised sequence.
invariants: no improvised sequential execution without preflight

relate.description: Add relationships between selected objects and an existing object. Uses canonical relationship fields.

merge.description: Consolidate multiple object IDs into one survivor, rewrite references, and retire losers through canonical delete lifecycle.

inputs.survivorId: Explicitly chosen by user — NOT automatic latest-updatedAt.
inputs.targetType: Explicitly chosen — independent from survivor identity.
inputs.propertyResolutions: Per-field resolution: equal=auto, one-side=suggest, collection=union-dedupe, conflict=explicit-choice.
inputs.preconditions: Survivor and losers must still exist; references must still be valid.

invariants: cross-type merge requires explicit target type
losers exit through canonical delete lifecycle
unknown fields preserved when serializer supports it
merge Undo only when evidence and hashes allow it

reference_rewrite.description: Repoint references from absorbed loser IDs to survivor ID. Reuses MergeService.repointReferences semantics via contract vectors.
invariants: unsupported reference representation is a blocker, not ignored
losers not deleted if reference rewrite fails

fix_identification.description: Fix an Issue where an object no longer matches its identification rule. Presents options without auto-correcting.
invariants: presents: Keep as Type, Change type, Review rule

rule_change.description: Appearance-only rule change: icon, color, emoji. No content migration needed.

rule_migration.description: Structural rule change: markerType or markerValue. Requires revision + transition protocol.

saveOnly.description: Writes new signature, increments revision, reindexes. Does NOT touch object content.

migrate.description: Starts transition, applies object migration, syncs/transports, commits revision.
invariants: transition persisted before first content write
old and new signatures are equivalent during transition
revision N+1 not ACTIVE until content transport confirmed
fail-closed if structural migrate and content sync is off without pending transport

scopeContract.description: Selection scope is a set of objects to operate on. A folder used as scope is NOT an Object Identification rule.
scopeContract.rule: Folder/file selection is a scope, not an Object Identification rule.

fields.includeSubfolders: Boolean — always shown, never inferred silently.
fields.eligibleMarkdownPaths: Markdown files that can be operated on.
fields.unidentifiedMarkdownPaths: Markdown files not yet identified as Quartzo objects.
fields.ignoredAttachments: Non-Markdown files ignored for object mutation.
fields.duplicatesRemoved: Count of paths deduplicated by normalized path.

revisionProtocol.description: Monotonic revision for Object Identification. Not clock-based.

fields.revision: Integer. Increments only when shared Object Identification semantics change.

transition.description: Present during structural migration. Both old and new signatures recognized as equivalent during transition.

fields.operation_id: Stable ID of the migration operation.
fields.phase: One of: planning, applying, awaiting_transport, committing, failed

rules: revision does not use updated_at as conflict resolver
planning phase NOT persisted remotely if no mutation has begun
transition cleared when revision N+1 commits
second client cannot start incompatible migration during active transition
structural TypeSignature edit is disabled during transition

issuesProjection.description: Reconstructible projection — not a persisted database.
rules: not_duplicates suppression requires canonical owner — otherwise omit from V1

sharedSettingsTargetedSync.description: Reconciles only app/quartzo_shared_settings.md using existing coordinator.
sharedSettingsTargetedSync.rule: Object operations do NOT use Shared Settings Sync to transport object bytes.

contentSyncOff.description: Object mutations remain local until content transport is available. Shared settings can still reconcile independently.
contentSyncOff.structuralMigrate: Cannot finalize new TypeSignature remotely while object content has no transport path. Transition persists until awaiting_transport resolves.

localOnly.description: No false Synced status. UI shows Local only.
